entries.title: Fixed Single-Column Cantilever Printer
entries.description: One newly authored complete single-column cantilever 3D-printer-style exterior: four feet and low base, one front-open vertical guide tower and fixed carriage, a true front-slotted one-sided crossrail, suspended fan-hood head and tapered nozzle above an independent lower Y-rail build bed, a side-supported complete bored double-flange material spool with a continuous fixed feed line, plus blank control wedge. All numeric geometry newly authored without old gantry, paper printer or cable-reel payload. Static opaque low-poly game-art only, one complete model zero scenes; no kinematics, printing, thermal or electrical operation, nozzle flow, calibration, fabrication, strength or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Six Pocket Billiard Table
entries.description: One newly authored whole static six-pocket billiard-table exterior. The continuous thick green playing bed has four curved corner cutouts and two complete semicircular side notches, each meeting one real open-top blind pocket cup with full wall and floor. Six separate raised cushion spans and thick wood rail spans leave those six mouths open. Four whole tapered grounded legs, supported underbed crossbeams and spine, and interrupted aprons carry the whole table while keeping the pocket openings visible. No old air-puck table goal frames, pinball cabinet or table-football rods/figures are imported, removed or recoloured; the complete new bed boundary and six-pocket perimeter layout are numerically authored for this whole model. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles; metres, Z up, full horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes, no independent pocket counts. Fixed empty appearance only: no balls/cues, ruleset or regulation dimensions, cushion rebound, cloth friction, ball path or return route, scoring, playability, human ergonomics, load, manufacture or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Annular-Pan Herb Edge Runner
entries.description: One newly authored complete static herb-preparation mill appearance for a fictional alchemy workshop. A whole shallow circular stone pan has a real annular open channel, complete floor, raised outer curb and integral central boss. A fixed vertical spindle and bored upper collar support one continuous radial double-cheek fork. A single upright thick bevelled stone wheel sits in the channel, its whole horizontal axle crossing both fork cheeks and its real centre bore. A long opposed sweep handle with an end grip belongs to the same upper carrier. The wheel lower flat tread facet meets the pan floor, while the fork leaves true side and upper clearances. All eleven editable closed solids are new; no old bowl, stamp mill, press frame or wheel arrays are imported. Four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, native Z up and actual complete horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One whole prop, zero scenes; neither repeated wheel counts nor decorations establish its novelty. Small static overlap fixes the carrier and wheel to their shafts, not a freely moving mechanism. Empty art only: no herbs, medicine, grinding output, rotation, transmission, operating procedure, chemical use, magic, calibration, load, material compatibility, manufacturing or safety claim.
